note: v2: flamboyant disco singer whose wardrobe morphs. No lip-sync. v1 shot ids (s*, c*) remain in ledger.json for history.

shots.prompt: A spotlight snaps on. The flamboyant disco singer throws a huge pose, points at the camera, sequins flashing, feather boa flying, the crowd cheering. Slow push in.
The singer freezes mid-pose, then slowly tilts their head back to stare straight up, as if reading glowing words floating above them. Disco lights pulse. Static camera.

The outfit transforms into a tailored pale-grey corporate suit with a white shirt, navy tie, ID lanyard and a headset microphone. Continuous on-camera transformation with no cuts: the outfit ripples and morphs like liquid fabric while the singer keeps dancing and posing to a funk groove. Same face, same afro, same stage and lighting.
